name: sitemap-url-extractor
title: Sitemap URL Extractor for SEO & AI Audits
description: Get every URL of a site for an SEO or AI audit, or to feed a crawler. Finds sitemaps through robots.txt and common paths, follows indexes and .gz files, and returns lastmod, changefreq, priority, image count, hreflang and an optional HTTP status. Filter by regex or date. Pay per URL kept.
seoTitle: Sitemap URL Extractor: All Website URLs for Audits
seoDescription: Get every URL of a site from its XML sitemaps, for SEO or AI audits or to feed a crawler. Follows indexes and .gz files. Filter by regex or date.
